common_issues.title: Single memory instance
common_issues.summary: If you add more than one Simple Memory node to your workflow, all nodes access the same memory instance by default. Be careful when doing destructive actions that override existing memory contents, such as the override all messages operation in the Chat Memory Manager node. If you want more than one memory instance in your workflow, set different session IDs in different memory nodes

common_issues.title: Managing the Session ID
common_issues.summary: In most cases, the sessionId is automatically retrieved from the On Chat Message trigger. But you may run into an error with the phrase No sessionId

parameters.name: scalingNotice
parameters.displayName: This node stores memory locally in the n8n instance. It is not compatible with Queue Mode or Multi-Main setups, as memory will not be shared across workers. For production use with scaling, consider using an external memory store such as Redis, Postgres, or another persistent memory node.
